title: Capstone 1: end-to-end agentic SDLC workflow
domain: Prepare agent architecture and SDLC processes
objective: Run a complete feature workflow from issue planning through agent execution, validation, review, and accountability evidence.
setup: Create a branch named capstone/agentic-sdlc-1. Use a harmless feature such as documentation, validation copy, or a sample service change.
steps: Write a GitHub issue as the task contract with goal, scope, forbidden areas, acceptance criteria, and evidence.
Define the agent plan and stop points before any implementation step.
Specify tool access, MCP allow list, branch scope, and environment constraints.
Simulate or perform the implementation on a branch and open a PR with evidence.
Run checks or write expected check evidence, then classify any failure.
Add a reviewer handoff that explains risks, approvals, rollback, and audit trail.
expectedResult: A complete issue-to-PR evidence trail showing how an agentic feature should be governed in GitHub.
validation: A reviewer can replay the workflow from issue to PR and see why each permission, check, review, and escalation point exists.
commonFailure: The workflow jumps from issue to code without explicit planning, tool boundaries, or reviewable evidence.
recovery: Return to the issue contract, add missing boundaries and validation evidence, then rerun the workflow from the last safe checkpoint.
examRelevance: Capstone labs build muscle memory for multi-domain GH-600 scenarios.
